title: 어린 왕자 (영어판) — What is essential is invisible to the eye
es: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
channel: Smile and Learn 동화 영어 번역 (사용자 녹음)
videoTitle: The Little Prince — English translation of the Smile and Learn story
summary: 스페인어 섹션의 「El Principito」 동화를 영어로 옮겨 읽은 오디오예요. 사막에 불시착한 비행사와 어린 왕자의 만남, 다섯 별의 이상한 어른들, 여우의 "길들인다는 것"까지 145문장을 쉬운 영어로 따라가요. 과거 시제 이야기체, 과거완료, used to·would 없이 쓰는 묘사, 그리고 tame·grown-up·odd one out 같은 표현을 익히기 좋아요. 스페인어판(es-2026-11-17-5)과 같은 문장 순서라 비교하며 들을 수 있어요.
topics: childhood: boa · swallow · grown-ups · odd one out
crash: engine failure · dunes · take off · survive
planet: baobab · sunset · weeds · pull up · burst
rose: thorns · vain · fragrance · run away
five planets: subject · admirer · businessman · lamplighter · geographer
fox: tame · create ties · grow fond of · patient
farewell: well · snake · nightmare · broad daylight

grammar.title: ① 과거진행 vs 단순과거 — while I was flying, … fell
grammar.lead: 배경(진행 중이던 일)은 was/were + -ing, 끼어든 사건은 단순과거예요. 스페인어의 불완료과거/단순과거 구분과 비슷해요.

head: 형태
쓰임
예문
rows: While I was flying over the desert, …
… my little plane had an engine failure.
The Little Prince lived on a very small planet.
When I got there, he was talking to a snake.

examples: While I was flying over the desert, my plane fell to the ground.
사막 위를 날던 중 비행기가 땅에 떨어졌다.
When I got there, he was talking to a snake.
내가 도착했을 때 그는 뱀과 이야기하고 있었다.
grammar.tip: 영어는 상태 동사(live, know, have)는 진행형을 잘 쓰지 않아요: He lived on a planet (✗ was living도 가능하지만 이야기체에선 단순과거가 자연스러워요).

grammar.title: ② 과거완료 had + p.p. — 그보다 더 이전
grammar.lead: 이야기 시점(과거)보다 더 앞선 일은 had + 과거분사로 말해요.

head: 예문
뜻
rows: For years I had lived in a world of grown-ups.
I had never felt comfortable in it.
I found he had fallen asleep.
The Little Prince had gone back to his planet.
어린 왕자는 자기 별로 돌아간 뒤였다

examples: After clapping for a while, he got tired.
한동안 박수 치고 나서 그는 지쳤다.
grammar.tip: should have + p.p. = "~했어야 했는데": I should never have run away. (절대 도망치지 말았어야 했어.)

grammar.title: ③ want/tell + 사람 + to 동사 — I want you to tame me
grammar.lead: 스페인어 querer que + 접속법이 영어에서는 want + 목적어 + to부정사가 돼요.

head: 구조
예문
뜻
rows: I want you to tame me.
I don't want you to go.
Clap until I tell you to stop.
내가 그만하라고 할 때까지 박수 쳐
Let me make this journey alone.
혼자 이 여행을 하게 해 줘
So that animals don't eat them.

examples: They told me to do something useful.
그들은 나에게 쓸모 있는 일을 하라고 했다.
grammar.tip: let 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형: let me go (✗ let me to go).

phrases: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
가장 중요한 것은 눈에 보이지 않아.
Will you draw me a sheep?
I have serious things to do.
There was no use arguing with him.
We must never forget the child we carry inside.
마음속에 품은 아이를 절대 잊으면 안 돼요.

vocab.ex: Boas could swallow a whole elephant.
vocab.exKo: 보아뱀은 코끼리를 통째로 삼킬 수 있었다.

vocab.ex: All the grown-ups told me the same thing.
I was always the odd one out.
My plane had an engine failure.
It was just the dunes and me.
If I couldn't take off, I wouldn't survive.
Tired of his insisting, I drew a box.
vocab.exKo: 계속 조르는 데 지쳐 상자를 그렸다.

vocab.ex: He loved watching sunsets.
vocab.exKo: 그는 해 지는 걸 보는 걸 좋아했다.

vocab.ex: You have to pull up the weeds right away.
Their roots can make the planet burst.
vocab.exKo: 그 뿌리가 별을 터뜨릴 수 있다.

vocab.ex: I have four thorns to defend myself.
vocab.exKo: 날 지킬 가시가 네 개 있어.

vocab.ex: She was vain and always needed his attention.
That flower filled my life with fragrance.
vocab.exKo: 그 꽃은 내 삶을 향기로 채웠다.

vocab.ex: He set off on a journey around several planets.
Ah, here is a subject!
He was lost in thought over those words.
Ah, an admirer!
He never stopped doing sums.
The lamplighter was the least absurd of them all.
Flowers are short-lived and disappear.
He regretted leaving his flower.
vocab.exKo: 그는 꽃을 두고 온 걸 후회했다.

vocab.ex: He came across a very beautiful animal.
I want you to tame me.
It means to create ties.
We'll grow fond of each other.
He was tireless.
Even though it was broad daylight, I froze.
Tell me this is all a nightmare.

quiz.q: What did the grown-ups think the drawing was?
quiz.explain: "What a nice hat!" — 보아뱀 그림을 모자로 봤어요.

quiz.q: Which drawing did the Little Prince finally like?
quiz.explain: 상자 안에 양이 있다고 했죠: "That's exactly what I wanted!"

quiz.q: While I ___ over the desert, my plane had an engine failure.
quiz.explain: 진행 중이던 배경 → 과거진행 was flying.

quiz.q: Why must weeds be pulled up right away?
options: Their roots can make the small planet burst
quiz.explain: "their huge roots can make it burst."

options: Demand what people are able to do
quiz.explain: "One must always demand what people are able to do."

options: The sun sets every five minutes but his job is the same
quiz.explain: "the sun sets every five minutes… my job on it is the same."

quiz.q: What does "tame" mean, according to the fox?

options: What is essential is invisible to the eye
There are no wells in the desert
quiz.explain: "What is essential is invisible to the eye."
